title: Counterbored M4 mounting plate
prompt: Mounting plate, 100 × 60 × 8 mm, centred on the origin and lying on Z = 0, with four holes for M4 socket head cap screws: standard clearance, counterbored from the top to the ISO 4762 size so the heads sit flush, on an 84 × 44 mm rectangle centred on the plate. Make the thickness a parameter called thick. Make them counterbored hole features with the M4 preset.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Four M4 counterbored holes: Ø4.5 normal clearance, ISO 4762 counterbore Ø8 × 4.4 deep, through, drilled from the top
Holes 8 mm in from both edges (84 × 44 rectangle)
The counterbores open in the top face (z = 8), where the prompt puts them
Eight cylindrical faces: a hole and a counterbore wall per screw
thick = 10 thickens the plate and keeps the counterbore depth: 58759 mm³

notes: ISO 4762 M4 counterbore (DIN 974-1): Ø8.0 × 4.4; ISO 273 normal clearance 4.5 (SPEC-v1 §6.5). Construction: cbores reads the hole features the prompt asks for (no geometry equivalent in the report), so a correct part built otherwise fails only that test.
